description: This file defines the WindowState class and associated functions for handling window state representations, including parsing from protocol buffer objects, creating window layout parameters, and extracting window attributes within an Android window management context.

classes.name: WindowState
classes.description: Represents the state of a window, including layout, type, and various attributes, with methods to instantiate from protocol buffer data.

methods.name: fromProto
methods.description: Static method to create a WindowState instance from a protocol buffer object, including window parameters, container, and attributes.
